tools.name: send_ticket_purchase_receipt_with_charge
tools.description: Charges the customer's saved payment method for a ticket order and emails them the receipt with the charge amount. Use it when an order is confirmed and payment has not yet been taken.

params.name: customer_email
params.description: Email address to send the receipt to

tools.code:
import smtplib
from contextlib import closing
from email.message import EmailMessage

import stripe
from agents import function_tool

SMTP_HOST = "smtp.ticketco.internal"


@function_tool
def send_ticket_purchase_receipt_with_charge(order_id: str, customer_email: str, amount_cents: int, payment_method_id: str) -> str:
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        payment_method=payment_method_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        metadata={"order_id": order_id},
        idempotency_key=f"order-{order_id}",
    )
    message = EmailMessage()
    message["From"] = "tickets@ticketco.example"
    message["To"] = customer_email
    message["Subject"] = f"Receipt for order {order_id}"
    message.set_content(f"We charged ${amount_cents / 100:.2f} for order {order_id}. Payment reference: {intent.id}")
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.send_message(message)
    return f"Charged {amount_cents} cents ({intent.id}) and emailed receipt to {customer_email}"

tools.name: refund_cancelled_event_order
tools.description: Looks up a ticket order, refunds the customer for the requested number of tickets, and updates the order record with the refunded amount and status. Returns a summary of the refund.
tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass

import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("ticketing")
DB_PATH = "ticketing.db"


@dataclass
class RefundResult:
    order_id: int
    refunded_cents: int
    refund_id: str
    status: str


@mcp.tool()
def refund_cancelled_event_order(order_id: int, ticket_count: int) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT payment_intent_id, unit_price_cents, quantity, refunded_cents FROM orders WHERE id = ?",
            (order_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Order {order_id} not found")
        if ticket_count < 1 or ticket_count > row["quantity"]:
            raise ValueError("Invalid ticket count")
        amount = row["unit_price_cents"] * ticket_count
        if row["refunded_cents"] + amount > row["unit_price_cents"] * row["quantity"]:
            raise ValueError("Refund exceeds order total")
        refund = stripe.Refund.create(
            payment_intent=row["payment_intent_id"],
            amount=amount,
            metadata={"order_id": str(order_id)},
        )
        total_refunded = row["refunded_cents"] + amount
        full = total_refunded == row["unit_price_cents"] * row["quantity"]
        status = "refunded" if full else "partially_refunded"
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE orders SET refunded_cents = ?, status = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (total_refunded, status, order_id),
        )
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    result = RefundResult(order_id, amount, refund.id, status)
    return result.__dict__

tools.name: transfer_ticket_to_new_holder
tools.description: Transfers a ticket to a new holder by reassigning ownership to their account and moving the ticket record from the original holder's wallet to the new holder's wallet.

params.name: ticket_id
params.description: ID of the ticket to transfer

params.name: current_holder_user_id
params.description: User ID of the current ticket holder

tools.code:
import sqlite3

from langchain_core.tools import tool

DATABASE_FILE_PATH = "ticketing.db"


@tool
def transfer_ticket_to_new_holder(ticket_id: str, current_holder_user_id: str, new_holder_user_id: str) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_FILE_PATH)
    try:
        existing_ticket_row_for_current_holder = database_connection.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM tickets WHERE id = ? AND owner_user_id = ?",
            (ticket_id, current_holder_user_id),
        ).fetchone()
        if existing_ticket_row_for_current_holder is None:
            raise ValueError("Ticket not found for the current holder")
        recipient_account_row = database_connection.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = ?",
            (new_holder_user_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        if recipient_account_row is None:
            raise ValueError("New holder account does not exist")
        database_connection.execute(
            "UPDATE tickets SET owner_user_id = ?, transfer_count = transfer_count + 1 WHERE id = ?",
            (new_holder_user_id, ticket_id),
        )
        database_connection.execute(
            "UPDATE wallet_items SET wallet_user_id = ? WHERE ticket_id = ? AND wallet_user_id = ?",
            (new_holder_user_id, ticket_id, current_holder_user_id),
        )
        database_connection.commit()
    except Exception:
        database_connection.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        database_connection.close()
    return f"Ticket {ticket_id} moved from {current_holder_user_id} to {new_holder_user_id}"

tools.name: cancel_reservation_and_notify_waitlist
tools.description: Permanently deletes a held seat reservation and sends a webhook to the waitlist service so the next person is offered the seat.

params.name: reservation_id
params.description: ID of the seat reservation to delete

params.name: event_id
params.description: ID of the event the seat belongs to

tools.code:
import sqlite3

import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("ticketing")


@mcp.tool()
def cancel_reservation_and_notify_waitlist(reservation_id: str, event_id: str) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect("ticketing.db")
    deleted_reservation_cursor = database_connection.execute(
        "DELETE FROM reservations WHERE id = ? AND event_id = ?", (reservation_id, event_id)
    )
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    waitlist_service_response = requests.post(
        "https://waitlist.ticketco.internal/api/seat-released",
        json={"event_id": event_id, "reservation_id": reservation_id},
        timeout=10,
    )
    waitlist_service_response.raise_for_status()
    return f"Deleted {deleted_reservation_cursor.rowcount} reservation(s) and notified waitlist"
